big: Nifty Auto is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Auto track?
The Nifty Auto Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the Automobiles segment of the financial market. It holds 15 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
